fact: The SNDS30 covers 2021-2030 with a first five-year action plan for 2021-2025, has been adopted and launched into implementation by the National Statistics Council, and provides annual progress reporting and a mid-term evaluation in 2025.
title: Stratégie Nationale de Développement de la Statistique 2021-2030, Volume 1 : Document de stratégie
publisher: Conseil National de la Statistique / Institut National de la Statistique
